subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: After the propagation defect is repaired, should OpenClaw land this embedded-only fail-closed mitigation while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92271 remains open for the other delegation surfaces?
rationale: Source review can establish correctness of the scoped guard, but cannot decide whether a tool-specific staged restriction is the intended product policy while related delegation tools remain available.

options.title: Land Repaired Mitigation
options.body: Fix and prove the CLI-to-embedded propagation, then accept the embedded guard as a staged mitigation while the canonical issue tracks remaining surfaces.

options.title: Require Full OpenClaw Parity
options.body: Hold this PR until one shared turn policy also covers OpenClaw-owned spawn, send, and scheduling surfaces.

options.title: Pause Fail-Closed Policy
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if fallback provenance should not disable an otherwise permitted delegation call.

recommendation.title: Land Repaired Mitigation
recommendation.body: Fix and prove the CLI-to-embedded propagation, then accept the embedded guard as a staged mitigation while the canonical issue tracks remaining surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: He established the cross-harness acceptance requirement and is the current assignee for this PR.
